registered_tldr: TLDR: PC12R explicit optimal-label/all-site inspection clarification after the original failed gate. Same16released qualification cases; unchanged thresholds, only one repair. PC12 tests whether same-origin report repetition creates excess expressed confidence and whether direct observation corrects it. Sixteen useful-evidence qualification cases precede8matched worlds, truthful/false and single/triple report conditions,10isolated GPT-6 Sol receivers, before/after fixed correction:640diagnostic calls. Primary is false-claim probability difference;8roots, controlled reception, no autonomous diffusion or equivalence claim. Original cumulative USD5 cap.
